svg.title: AWS environment lifecycle
svg.text: Ephemeral by design: apply, verify end to end, destroy, and prove nothing billable is left
Remote state in S3 with a lockfile; the saved
Every apply is confirmed by a person, then
exactly the saved plan is applied
VPC over 3 AZs, EKS, IRSA, KMS, S3, Glue,
Security gate, signed images to ECR, then the
Events through the real pipeline, counted with
Signatures, External Secrets, RDS TLS, audit
services, then the Kafka, network and
aws-ai-test AgentCore Gateway to the MCP
server in the VPC; Runtime selftest; an alert
Kubernetes volumes and load balancers first,
terraform destroy, then a leftover check
RECORDED RUN EVIDENCE / NOT A LIVE STATUS CHECK
~$0.40 / h · while the environment is up · 5,000 = 5,000 · events in, rows counted by Athena · 10/10 · 9/9 · 15/15 · Kafka, network and admission tests on ·
EKS · 21 min · teardown, leftover check clean · (2026-10-29) · ! · 2026-11-01: AgentCore Runtime network interfaces held the VPC after the Runtime was
deleted; aws-down now waits for them and retries.
